From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novomedics.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@novomedics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 23:15:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call recap & proposed pilot playbook for NovoMedics

Hi Liam / Sara —

Thanks again for a focused call earlier today. Quick recap and the pilot playbook we discussed so we have aligned next steps. Please review and let me know any edits; if this looks good well treat this as the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to get to a pilot PO.

Top pain & goals (your words):
- Primary pain: high false-positive rate in clinical triage workflows, ~18% downstream review load.
- Goal: reduce manual review by 50% on triage rules and shave per-case review time by 30% within the pilot scope.
- Constraint: PHI must remain in-customer VPC if we process raw images/data; otherwise only hashed metadata allowed.

Pilot success metrics (MVP):
- 50% reduction in manual triage volume on test cohort (10k records)
- Latency: sub-200ms median on inference for batched API calls
- Data residency: all raw inputs kept in NovoMedics VPC during pilot

Proposed milestones & owners (dates are suggested):
1) Pilot intake & data access (owner: NovoMedics - Sara) — target by 2027-03-24
2) Security review & data flow sign-off (owner: NovoMedics security + Redwood security) — target by 2027-03-31
3) Pilot deploy (sandbox in customer VPC) & first smoke tests (owner: Redwood SE - Monica) — target by 2027-04-07
4) Initial quality run & metric review (joint) — target by 2027-04-14
5) Exec review & procurement decision (owner: NovoMedics execs) — target by 2027-04-21

Decision process & stakeholders I heard on the call:
- Technical/stakeholder champions: Liam (Product Ops), Sara (IT/Security)
- Procurement path: single PO from NovoMedics procurement team, exec sign-off required (target: 2027-04-21)
- Success approver: VP Clinical Ops (final approval after metrics review)

Attachments: Im attaching a lightweight MPA workbook (novomedics-mpa-v1.xlsx) and our standard data privacy QA (data-privacy-qa.pdf) for your security team.

Next asks (simple):
- Can you confirm the intake owner (Sara) and that 2027-03-24 is OK for data access?
- Please add the procurement contact if different from the address you gave.
- Flag any blockers in the security checklist in the attached PDF and well iterate.

If I dont hear back by Friday (2027-03-12), well hold the milestone dates but Ill follow up with a short call invite to resolve any outstanding items.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—
Avery Johnson
Senior Solutions Executive
Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: novomedics-mpa-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), data-privacy-qa.pdf (PDF)

Avery — thanks for the crisp summary, really helpful. A couple of quick notes from our side:

- Dates: 2027-03-24 for initial intake is tight for our data team (end of quarter work). Can we move intake to 2027-03-29 and shift the subsequent milestones by ~1 week?
- Procurement: adding procurement@novomedics.com to this thread; procurement will need the commercial summary and draft SOW to start their internal process.
- Security: Ravi Menon (ccd) is our security lead and will do the initial review; he may ask for the security questionnaire pre-filled if you have a shortcut version.
- Decision timeline: exec sign-off target is the week of 2027-04-18 (VP Clinical Ops calendar looks open then).

If you can update the MPA with the shifted dates and include a 1-page commercial summary, wel tee this up with procurement.

Liam
